Mark saw Andrew waiting at the airport from 3pm to 7pm.
The park was closed after 10pm.
Between what times could Andrew have gone to the park?

Options:
(A) 6am to 7am
(B) 9am to 12pm
(C) 7pm to 10pm
(D) 7am to 9am

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)
